name: Accruals Anomaly Feasibility Check (Sloan 1996)
source: Sloan, R.G. (1996), "Do Stock Prices Fully Reflect Information in Accruals and Cash Flows about Future Earnings?", The Accounting Review 71(3): 289-315.
hypothesis: Firms with lower accruals outperform those with higher accruals. Dollar-neutral long-short (long low accruals, short high accruals, inverse-vol weighted, monthly rebalance) should produce a market-neutral edge on 2014-2026 large_liquid.

data_feasibility_check.rationale: yfinance quarterly fundamentals only available from ~2025. A 504-day formation window requires data from ~2012-2013. The earliest possible walk-forward would start in ~2027, making a 2014-2026 backtest impossible.

decision: DATA-INFEASIBLE - cannot support pre-registered 2014-2026 walk-forward with 504-day formation window. No OOS Sharpe gate evaluated.
